facts.value: Allocation is rejected when an enabled numeric limit has used >= num_limit. While capped, recovery above heap_limit_size resets the cap to UINT_MAX. Allocation is then rejected at used >= heap_limit_num. An empty free list triggers one-object replenishment and fails if it remains empty; success transitions one entry from free to used and updates the historical peak.
